title: Two-fluid manifold-aware conjugate heat-transfer qualification

current_status.summary: A retained-evidence audit corrected the field-stationarity predicate, confirmed continuation monitor rows through 1000 s, and identified local-region, pressure-reference, and energy/interface evidence limitations. No CFD was rerun.

authority_note: These are retained OpenFOAM fixture results, not physical validation or design release.
next_action: Pressure/velocity diagnostics are complete. The next bounded experiment should vary pressure-correction count and p_rgh relaxation one control at a time, using repaired solid-e residual telemetry; preserve v5/v7 and do not weaken gates or start HX-03 Stage B until residual and monitor gates are established.

solver_control_diagnostic.scope: Isolated coarse v7 copy, nOuterCorrectors 1 versus 2, through 100 s for the control.
solver_control_diagnostic.interpretation: The bounded control does not establish an improvement in the existing initial-residual metric. Final linear residuals are not substituted for the qualification gate.

pressure_velocity_diagnostic.pressure_equation: p_rgh remains high in both fluid regions; outlet pressure references and pressureInletOutletVelocity BCs were inspected.
pressure_velocity_diagnostic.transverse_velocity: q95 transverse speed is concentrated within the first 50 mm from each inlet and decays through the exchanger core.
pressure_velocity_diagnostic.outlet_backflow: No reverse-flow cells were detected in retained shell/tube outlet snapshots.
